title: Chapter 231 The Farmer'S Thoughts
content:
Chapter 231 The Farmer'S Thoughts

As for Tian Guang, why is this peasant hero so hostile to Yu Guo? It is because his farm disciples are the most numerous in the world, and the distribution is also the widest, so the impact of this war is also the most serious.

The peasant family is not an elite school like Taoism, but a broad grassroots school.

Many of the disciples in the farm school are ordinary people who don't even have internal strength. They just heard about the reputation of the farm and came to join them, and they were accepted.

It is precisely because of this kind of wide opening of the mountain gate that the peasant family's momentum is the most prosperous in the world, and it is said that every county, every town, and every town in the world has disciples of the peasant family.

It is precisely because of this distribution that the disciples of the farm family suffered heavy casualties.

After all, most of the peasant's disciples were ordinary people without much internal strength, and they couldn't resist the countless troops that were pressed by the imperial court.

Therefore, under the search and arrest of the army, they could only obediently follow the government, and go to the army together to serve as cannon fodder for various countries.

After this arrest, a total of 50,000 to 60,000 people in the farming family suffered, and all of them were dragged to the battlefield and became insignificant consumables.

Up to now, these 50,000 to 60,000 people have almost been exhausted, and there are only a few left.

Even the deaths of these 50,000 to 60,000 people are not a big deal. After all, there are so many farmers, even if they are half of them, there are still 50,000 to 60,000 people. In Jianghu, it is still a top force that can run rampant in the world and disdain all schools of thought. .

For these schools, in addition to their own ideas, force is also a very important factor, especially the top masters are very important.

Those who die in the peasant family are ordinary people. As long as their high-level people, that is, those first-rate and second-rate masters, are not dead, after the world is settled, they will go to various places to make random moves, and that will be another university school with 100,000 people.

Therefore, the death of these cannon fodder is not very concerned about the farmer's heart. What is really serious is the next development.

The damage caused by the war has been so serious that no one can imagine. The strongholds of the farmhouses have become ruins due to the war. The countless industries they used to make profits have gradually become deserted due to the death of the population and the abandonment of the towns. .

All of a sudden, the farmer's money bag was broken.

Afterwards, the war continued, and the remaining half of the disciples of the farm family were also being consumed.

After all, to support so many people, the farm family undoubtedly fought for interests with the dignitaries everywhere in the world. Among them were the rulers of various countries. They had long been secretly jealous and envious of the huge farm family.

Now that the peasant family is weak, the world is full of heroes, and strong troops and bandits can be seen everywhere, so why wouldn't they take this opportunity to severely weaken the peasant family!

Therefore, the imperial court is not afraid of targeting them, what is afraid of is local snakes everywhere, and their attacks on farmers.

Over the past two years, most of the remaining power of the farm family has been destroyed under their blows, and only some elite members have been able to evacuate.

Up to now, the huge monster that claimed to have 100,000 disciples, and as long as there are places where it can move, there are farm disciples, but now only a mere 5,000 capable disciples survive.

And the rest of these people have also shrunk their sphere of influence back to Chu State, their original base territory, and the situation is not very good. They have also been suppressed by powerful figures in Chu State.

He no longer regained the prestige of the first-class power in the world, and the prestige of the peasant hero who was known as the hidden monarch because the strength of the peasant family was comparable to a small country.

So how could the peasant family fall into such a situation, their hero Tian Guang, how could they not hate the instigator of all this, the co-director of the alliance, Yuguo?

"Okay, you two, you have said so much, what is the situation, you have to continue to watch!" As a major force against Qin, the current temporary leader of the Mohist family, who is well-known in the world, has his head full. The white-haired class master persuaded.

Xiaoyaozi heard the words, looked at the short and stooped body of the class master, nodded, and stopped talking. However, Tian Guang glanced contemptuously, snorted coldly with disdain, crossed his arms, and did not answer.

"You, you dare to underestimate our giant like this, it's too arrogant!" Bandit Zhi behind Master Ban, who was impatient, couldn't bear it when he saw Tian Guang's performance, and took the lead in asking questions.

Although today's Mohism, after the death of its predecessor, the six-fingered black man, has become somewhat disintegrated, with no leader among the dragons. But the Mohist school is still the first-class force in the world, and it is still a top school with tens of thousands of disciples and influence all over the world.

In particular, the Mohism's organ techniques are favored by all countries in the world, especially the six Kanto countries that resisted the Qin State. There are too many aspects that need the help of the Mohist's organ art in defending the city or resisting Qin's aggression.

With the help of this, the Mo family is very popular in the six countries, and few people make things difficult for him, but open the door of convenience everywhere. Because the countries don't know when they will be attacked by the Qin State, and when they will use the Mohist mechanism.

With the help of this condition, the Mohist family suffered less losses in this catastrophe. Under the official hints, the local snakes rarely made things difficult for the Mohist family, allowing the Mohist family's strength to be completely preserved.

It is also for this reason that the peasant family represented by Tian Guang is so hostile to the Mohist family. Why do I suffer heavy losses, but your Mohist family is intact? This is not fair.

"Oh, do I despise your Mo family? Is there anything worthy of my attention in your Mo family? Since the death of the previous Mo family giant, the Mo family has no leader, and there is not even a strong one who can stand on the stage. Only two or three of you are first-rate Beginning masters, I can easily find dozens of them by simply swiping. Excuse me, what do you want me to respect about your Mo family? What is there in your Mo family that deserves my respect!" With a sneer, Tian Guang was very satisfied Disdainful, full of sarcasm in the words of the Mohists.

In fact, Tian Guang was very respectful to the previous leader of the Mo family, that is, the six-fingered black man, and the relationship between the farm family and the Mo family was relatively close.

After all, both of them hate Qin State very much, and hope that all countries in the world can get along with each other, so they have a common discourse, and in terms of high-level strength, there is a Mohist giant who is a first-class late-stage master, as well as a large number of Mohist disciples. The farmers are not much different, so they have the status and foundation for cooperation.

Even in a certain period of time, the peasant family and the Mohist school were almost regarded as the same faction by the Jianghu people, belonging to a close alliance, regardless of each other.

However, after the death of the Mohist giant, the situation is different. Before this giant was a master, he was enough to be number one.
